description: A script for launching and managing Docker-based test environments for prplMesh, including version checks, container orchestration, and cleanup.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Manages Docker services, including setup, configuration, and execution of test environments based on JSON configuration files.

methods.name: check_docker_versions
methods.description: Checks if installed Docker and Docker Compose versions meet minimum requirements.

methods.name: Services.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Services class, setting up directories, reading device configurations, and preparing environment variables.

methods.name: Services._get_device_names
methods.description: Reads device names from a JSON configuration file.

methods.name: Services.get_build_id
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a build ID based on environment variables or existing logs.

methods.name: Services.dc
methods.description: Runs docker-compose commands with environment setup, optionally in interactive mode.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Exits the script with a message if the return code indicates failure.
